dialogues.jp: ……さて、次は体育か。
dialogues.en: ...Let's see, next is gym class.
dialogues.text: ...Let's see, next is gym class.

dialogues.jp:
休み時間に入ると、俺は気合を入れて席を立ち
上がった。
dialogues.en:
As we entered the break period, I gathered my guts and stood
up.
dialogues.text:
As we entered the break period, I gathered my guts and stood
up.

dialogues.jp: 「ほらほら、おまえらとっとと出てけ！」
dialogues.en: "Alright you guys, get outta here!"
dialogues.text: "Alright you guys, get outta here!"

dialogues.jp:
いつものように男連中の背を強引に押して教室
から追い出す。
dialogues.en: As usual, I chase the other guys out of the classroom.
dialogues.text: As usual, I chase the other guys out of the classroom.

dialogues.speaker: Male A
dialogues.jp: 「あー、まーた始まった」
dialogues.en: "Gaah, it starts."
dialogues.text: "Gaah, it starts."

dialogues.jp:
ここしばらく体育の時間には決まって繰り返さ
れる俺の行動に、男子連中は呆れ笑いを浮かべ
ている。
dialogues.en:
The other male students shook their heads in amazement as I
hurried them out.
dialogues.text:
The other male students shook their heads in amazement as I
hurried them out.

dialogues.speaker: Male B
dialogues.jp: 「そんなに王子様を独り占めしたいかねー」
dialogues.en: "Don't keep the prince all to yourself~"
dialogues.text: "Don't keep the prince all to yourself~"

dialogues.speaker: Male B
dialogues.jp:
「ふふふッ、何とでもいうがよい、はい行った
　行った」
dialogues.en: "Hahaha, say whatever you want, just keep moving."
dialogues.text: "Hahaha, say whatever you want, just keep moving."

dialogues.jp:
蹴出すようにしてなんとか全員追い出した。こ
れで一安心だ。
dialogues.en:
I finally kicked out the last of the stragglers, and
breathed a sigh of relief.
dialogues.text:
I finally kicked out the last of the stragglers, and
breathed a sigh of relief.

dialogues.jp: 「はい、邪魔者たちは追い出したぞ」
dialogues.en: "Okay, the nuisances are gone."
dialogues.text: "Okay, the nuisances are gone."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉君…………やりすぎだってば……」
dialogues.en: "Asakura... that's rather excessive..."
dialogues.text: "Asakura... that's rather excessive..."

dialogues.jp: 工藤は困ったように俺を見る。
dialogues.en: Kudou glanced at me worryingly.
dialogues.text: Kudou glanced at me worryingly.

dialogues.jp:
「これくらいが丁度いいんだよ、あいつらは飢
　えた狼なんだから」
dialogues.en: "Nah, it was needed. Those guys are like starving wolves."
dialogues.text: "Nah, it was needed. Those guys are like starving wolves."

dialogues.jp:
それでなくても最近可愛いくなったと評判なの
に、飢えた狼の群れの中で、着替えるなんて、
いくらなんでも危険すぎる。
dialogues.en:
With all the rumours about us flying about, and with those
gossipers out there, it would be far too dangerous.
dialogues.text:
With all the rumours about us flying about, and with those
gossipers out there, it would be far too dangerous.

dialogues.jp:
俺の目の黒いうちはそんなこと、工藤にさせる
わけにはいかない。
dialogues.en:
I wouldn't let us undergo that, I thought, as I turned my
head to face her.
dialogues.text:
I wouldn't let us undergo that, I thought, as I turned my
head to face her.

dialogues.jp:
「それしても、……よくいままで無事だったよ
　な」
dialogues.en: "Although... you've done well to not be noticed at all."
dialogues.text: "Although... you've done well to not be noticed at all."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「……隅っこのほうで、目立たないようにぱっ
　と着替えてたから」
dialogues.en:
"...I go to the corner and change quickly, so that I don't
stand out."
dialogues.text:
"...I go to the corner and change quickly, so that I don't
stand out."

dialogues.jp: 工藤は恥ずかしそうに小声で答える。
dialogues.en: Kudou whispered in a tiny voice.
dialogues.text: Kudou whispered in a tiny voice.

dialogues.jp:
そ、そーか……目立たないようにして気づかれ
なければ別に危険はないわけであって……。
dialogues.en:
T, that's true... what I've done now has basically made us
stand out even more...
dialogues.text:
T, that's true... what I've done now has basically made us
stand out even more...

dialogues.jp: （…………もしかしてやっちまったか？　俺？）
dialogues.en: "(......Did I just do something stupid?)"
dialogues.text: "(......Did I just do something stupid?)"

dialogues.jp:
「コホン……と、とにかく遠慮せずに着替えろ
　よ。早くしないと授業が始まるぞ」
dialogues.en:
"Ahem... a, anyway, you should change quickly. Gym's going
to start soon."
dialogues.text:
"Ahem... a, anyway, you should change quickly. Gym's going
to start soon."

dialogues.jp: 話を逸らすように工藤を促した。
dialogues.en: I quickly changed the subject.
dialogues.text: I quickly changed the subject.

dialogues.jp:
しかし彼女は着替えようとせず、もじもじとそ
こに立ち尽くしたままだ。
dialogues.en:
But rather than start changing, she stood in place,
fidgeting slightly.
dialogues.text:
But rather than start changing, she stood in place,
fidgeting slightly.

dialogues.jp: 「……ん？　どうかした？」
dialogues.en: "...Hm? Something wrong?"
dialogues.text: "...Hm? Something wrong?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉君も……出てって」
dialogues.en: "Um... Asakura... ahem. Could you.... go out too?"
dialogues.text: "Um... Asakura... ahem. Could you.... go out too?"

dialogues.jp: そう言いながら、後ろのドアを指差す。
dialogues.en: She pointed to the door as she mumbled.
dialogues.text: She pointed to the door as she mumbled.

dialogues.jp:
……なるほど、そういうことですか。そいつは
まったくさっぱり失念していたな。
dialogues.en:
...Oh right, that's how it is. It completely slipped my
mind.
dialogues.text:
...Oh right, that's how it is. It completely slipped my
mind.

dialogues.jp:
「……取りあえず目立たないように一緒に着替
　える？」
dialogues.en: "...To stay inconspicious, shouldn't we change together?"
dialogues.text: "...To stay inconspicious, shouldn't we change together?"

dialogues.jp: 羞恥に加え、憤りに叶の頬がさらに紅潮する。
dialogues.en:
Kudou's cheeks flushed red immediately, partly wtih
embarassment, and partly with indignation.
dialogues.text:
Kudou's cheeks flushed red immediately, partly wtih
embarassment, and partly with indignation.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「そんなわけないでしょう！　もう、エッチな
　んだから！！」
dialogues.en: "O, o, of course not! That's too embarassing..."
dialogues.text: "O, o, of course not! That's too embarassing..."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「……はいはい、すみませんでした」
dialogues.en: "...Please, leave now..."
dialogues.text: "...Please, leave now..."

dialogues.jp:
俺は己の体操着を抱えてすごすごとその場を退
散したのだった。
dialogues.en: Holding my own PE uniform, I dejectedly left the room.
dialogues.text: Holding my own PE uniform, I dejectedly left the room.

dialogues.jp:
隣の教室に溜まって着替えていたクラスの奴ら
は、俺が顔を見せると一斉に冷やかした。
dialogues.en:
The taunts started the moment I entered the neighbouring
classroom, where all the guys had gathered to change.
dialogues.text:
The taunts started the moment I entered the neighbouring
classroom, where all the guys had gathered to change.

dialogues.speaker: Boy
dialogues.jp: 「なんだ朝倉〜、王子様に嫌われたか」
dialogues.en: "What happened, Asakura~. Seems the prince rejected you."
dialogues.text: "What happened, Asakura~. Seems the prince rejected you."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「なんぞご無体でも仕掛けたのか？」
dialogues.en: "Were you forced out lile the rest of us commoners?"
dialogues.text: "Were you forced out lile the rest of us commoners?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「お前と一緒にするな」
dialogues.en: "Don't lump me together with the rest of you."
dialogues.text: "Don't lump me together with the rest of you."

dialogues.jp:
ニヤニヤ笑う杉並の頭を一発はたいて、俺は急
いで着替え始めた。
dialogues.en:
I tapped the sneering Suginami's head with my fist lightly,
and started changing.
dialogues.text:
I tapped the sneering Suginami's head with my fist lightly,
and started changing.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「キャッッ」
dialogues.en: "Kyaa!"
dialogues.text: "Kyaa!"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.en: "...Whoa."
dialogues.text: "...Whoa."

dialogues.jp:
廊下に出たところで眞子とぶつかりそうになっ
た。
dialogues.en: I collided with Mako as I exited into the corridor.
dialogues.text: I collided with Mako as I exited into the corridor.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「ちょっと〜、気をつけなさいよね」
dialogues.en: "Geez, be more careful!"
dialogues.text: "Geez, be more careful!"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「悪ぃ悪ぃ」
dialogues.en: "Sorry, sorry."
dialogues.text: "Sorry, sorry."

dialogues.jp:
今日は女子、これから家庭科か……楽そうで
いいよな。
dialogues.en: Today, the girls get to do home economics... how easy.
dialogues.text: Today, the girls get to do home economics... how easy.

dialogues.jp:
（ほんとなら……工藤もそっちで授業を受ける
　はずなんだよな………………）
dialogues.en:
"(Kudou really should be doing that instead of this
torture...)"
dialogues.text:
"(Kudou really should be doing that instead of this
torture...)"

dialogues.jp:
眞子の抱える家庭科の教材を眺めて、ちょっと
複雑な気持ちになる俺。
dialogues.en:
Mako stared at me, holding her home economics items, as I
pondered my complex feelings.
dialogues.text:
Mako stared at me, holding her home economics items, as I
pondered my complex feelings.

dialogues.jp: 眞子は妙な表情で俺の顔をまじまじと眺めた。
dialogues.en:
Mako's weird look at me was starting to make me feel
uncomfortable.
dialogues.text:
Mako's weird look at me was starting to make me feel
uncomfortable.

dialogues.jp: 「……な、なんだよ」
dialogues.en: "...W, what is it?"
dialogues.text: "...W, what is it?"

dialogues.jp:
別にやましいところなどないのだが、じっと見
られるとたじろぎ気味になる。
dialogues.en:
Her staring was making me feel as if I'd done something
wrong.
dialogues.text:
Her staring was making me feel as if I'd done something
wrong.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「あのさ……こないだから、聞こう聞こうと思っ
　てたんだけど………………」
dialogues.en: "Just... thinking about the stuff I've heard lately..."
dialogues.text: "Just... thinking about the stuff I've heard lately..."

dialogues.jp: 眞子は一旦言葉をとめた。
dialogues.en: Mako trailed off partway into her sentence.
dialogues.text: Mako trailed off partway into her sentence.

dialogues.jp:
何かあたりさわりのない表現を探すように、か
すかに首を傾げておもむろに口を開く。
dialogues.en:
I tried to act like I was completely clueless, and she
opened her mouth again.
dialogues.text:
I tried to act like I was completely clueless, and she
opened her mouth again.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「あんた……いつから属性男好きにチェンジし
　たのよ？」
dialogues.en: "You... when did you start liking guys?"
dialogues.text: "You... when did you start liking guys?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: （おっと、そう来たか）
dialogues.en: "(Oh boy, here it comes.)"
dialogues.text: "(Oh boy, here it comes.)"

dialogues.jp: 俺はつとめて平静を装いながら答えた。
dialogues.en:
I calmed myself as much as possible, and got ready to
answer.
dialogues.text:
I calmed myself as much as possible, and got ready to
answer.

dialogues.jp:
……別に俺と工藤になんらやましい所は無い、
フツーにすれば良いのだ。フツーに。
dialogues.en:
...There's nothing wrong at all between me and Kudou. It's
all normal. Completely.
dialogues.text:
...There's nothing wrong at all between me and Kudou. It's
all normal. Completely.

dialogues.jp:
「まぁた、くだらん噂を真に受ける！　お前、
　進学してもなんにも変わってねーな」
dialogues.en:
"You're still treating such stupid rumours as the truth!
Hah, even after middle school, you haven't changed at all."
dialogues.text:
"You're still treating such stupid rumours as the truth!
Hah, even after middle school, you haven't changed at all."

dialogues.jp:
馬鹿にされたと感じたのだろう。眞子はきっと
顔をあげ、俺の目の前に指を突きつけてきた。
dialogues.en:
Hostility was starting to emnate from her. She faced me
directly, and pointed an accusatory finger.
dialogues.text:
Hostility was starting to emnate from her. She faced me
directly, and pointed an accusatory finger.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「この頃のアンタと工藤君、どー見てもおかし
　いわよっ！　あれは単なる友情の域を超えて
　るわ」
dialogues.en:
"You and Kudou have been acting so strange and close
recently! That definitely goes further than normal
friendship!"
dialogues.text:
"You and Kudou have been acting so strange and close
recently! That definitely goes further than normal
friendship!"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「断じて俺にはホモっ気などない！　天地神明
　に誓ってもだ！」
dialogues.en: "I'm telling you, I'm not a homo! I swear to God, I'm not!"
dialogues.text: "I'm telling you, I'm not a homo! I swear to God, I'm not!"

dialogues.jp: 力強く訴えた。
dialogues.en: I appealed strongly.
dialogues.text: I appealed strongly.

dialogues.jp: それは嘘じゃないしな。
dialogues.en: That isn't a lie, after all.
dialogues.text: That isn't a lie, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「……やけにはっきり言い切るわねぇ」
dialogues.en: "...Saying that out of pure desperation, huh."
dialogues.text: "...Saying that out of pure desperation, huh."

dialogues.jp:
なぜなら俺の恋する工藤叶は、れっきとした女
の子なんだから。
dialogues.en:
But it's the truth, since the Kudou Kanae that I love, is
actually a girl...
dialogues.text:
But it's the truth, since the Kudou Kanae that I love, is
actually a girl...

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉、お待たせ」
dialogues.en: "Asakura, I'm done."
dialogues.text: "Asakura, I'm done."

dialogues.jp:
からり、とドアが開く気配とともに工藤が顔を
見せる。
dialogues.en: Suddenly, the door opened, and Kudou walked out.
dialogues.text: Suddenly, the door opened, and Kudou walked out.

dialogues.jp:
ナイスかバッドか、絶妙すぎるタイミングだっ
た。
dialogues.en: What absolutely perfect timing.
dialogues.text: What absolutely perfect timing.

dialogues.jp: 「お……おう」
dialogues.en: "I... see."
dialogues.text: "I... see."

dialogues.jp:
俺は右手を軽くあげて、無理無理にこしらえた
笑顔をみせる。
dialogues.en: I waved my hand slightly, and forced a smile.
dialogues.text: I waved my hand slightly, and forced a smile.

dialogues.jp:
眞子の疑惑の視線が、俺の後頭部にぶっすりと
刺さっているのを感じる。
dialogues.en:
I could feel Mako's doubtful glare piercing through the back
of my head.
dialogues.text:
I could feel Mako's doubtful glare piercing through the back
of my head.

dialogues.jp:
言いたいことは山ほどあるが、どれから口にし
たものとか迷っている様子だ。
dialogues.en:
Although I was talking big just now, my train of thought
came to a crashing halt thanks to Kudou.
dialogues.text:
Although I was talking big just now, my train of thought
came to a crashing halt thanks to Kudou.

dialogues.jp:
眞子はいろんなところから噂を集めては来るも
のの、無節操にそれを広めたりはしない。
dialogues.en:
Now this meeting with Mako is sure add even more fuel to the
fire.
dialogues.text:
Now this meeting with Mako is sure add even more fuel to the
fire.

dialogues.jp: 何だかんだ言ってこいつはいい奴だから……。
dialogues.en: What can I do to get out of this...
dialogues.text: What can I do to get out of this...

dialogues.jp: 「っと！　ほら、工藤、急ぐぜ」
dialogues.en: "Whoops! Come on Kudou, let's go!"
dialogues.text: "Whoops! Come on Kudou, let's go!"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「うん」
dialogues.en: "Yeah."
dialogues.text: "Yeah."

dialogues.jp:
鐘の音に急かされ、俺はごく自然に工藤の手を
とって走り出した。
dialogues.en:
Saved by the bell, I grabbed Kudou's hand and started
walking quickly.
dialogues.text:
Saved by the bell, I grabbed Kudou's hand and started
walking quickly.

dialogues.jp: 「たっしゃでな〜」
dialogues.en: "Take care~"
dialogues.text: "Take care~"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「……あんたの言ってること、やっぱ全然説
　得力ないじゃない！！」
dialogues.en: "...Your words aren't convincing at all!"
dialogues.text: "...Your words aren't convincing at all!"

dialogues.jp:
眞子のそんな捨て台詞を、背中で受け流しなが
ら。
dialogues.en: Mako's thrown words simply bounced off my back.
dialogues.text: Mako's thrown words simply bounced off my back.

dialogues.jp: ◆薔薇色の日々２◆
dialogues.en: ◆Rose-Coloured Days 2◆
dialogues.text: ◆Rose-Coloured Days 2◆

dialogues.jp:
叶と俺との関係が妙な噂になっているらしい。
眞子にまでツッコミを入れられてしまったが、
dialogues.en:
There's been weird rumours about the connection between me
and Kanae.
dialogues.text:
There's been weird rumours about the connection between me
and Kanae.

dialogues.jp: 仕方ない。これも愛の為だ。
dialogues.en:
Mako saw through my facade easily, but it can't be helped.
It's all for love.
dialogues.text:
Mako saw through my facade easily, but it can't be helped.
It's all for love.
